title: 배달 앱으로 음식 시키기
objective: Read the key parts of a delivery-app order screen and write a short request to the restaurant or rider, such as '문 앞에 두고 벨은 누르지 말아 주세요.'
summary: Ten words you will see on a Korean food-delivery app, from the order screen (delivery fee, minimum order amount, estimated arrival time) to the request box (outside the door, doorbell, disposable spoon and chopsticks). Each word comes with one real-life example sentence.

task.title: READ, CHOOSE, AND WRITE
task.line: Use the ten words above to fill in blanks, read a short order screen, and write delivery requests in Korean.

words.meaning: delivery fee (the extra charge for bringing food to you)
minimum order amount (you must spend at least this much to order)
words.example: 최소 주문 금액이 안 돼서 음료를 하나 더 시켰어요.
words.exampleMeaning: I was under the minimum order amount, so I added one more drink.

words.meaning: takeout, pickup (you go and get the food yourself)
words.exampleMeaning: Today I'll order for pickup, not delivery.

words.meaning: special requests (the box where you write notes for your order)
words.example: 요청 사항에 '안 맵게 해 주세요'라고 썼어요.
words.exampleMeaning: In the request box, I wrote 'Please make it not spicy.'

words.example: 집에 수저가 있으니까 일회용 수저는 안 주셔도 돼요.
words.exampleMeaning: I have a spoon and chopsticks at home, so you don't need to include disposable ones.

words.meaning: outside the door, at the front door (where food is left)
words.exampleMeaning: Please leave it outside the door.

words.example: 아기가 자고 있어서 벨은 누르지 말아 주세요.
words.exampleMeaning: The baby is sleeping, so please don't ring the doorbell.

words.meaning: estimated arrival time (when the food should arrive)
words.example: 도착 예정 시간이 7시 40분인데 아직 안 왔어요.
words.exampleMeaning: The estimated arrival time was 7:40, but it hasn't come yet.

words.meaning: canceling an order (also the 'cancel order' button)
words.example: 메뉴를 잘못 골라서 주문 취소를 눌렀어요.
words.exampleMeaning: I chose the wrong menu item, so I pressed 'cancel order.'

words.meaning: review (a comment and star rating you leave after eating)
words.example: 음식이 맛있어서 사진이랑 같이 리뷰를 남겼어요.
words.exampleMeaning: The food was good, so I left a review with a photo.

exercises: Fill in the blank with a word from the list: 이 가게는 ____이 15,000원이에요. 그래서 김밥 한 줄만 시킬 수 없어요.
Choose the right word (배달 / 포장): 제가 가게에 가서 직접 가져갈게요. ____으로 주문할게요.
Read the order screen and answer in English. What time should the food arrive, and how much is the delivery fee?: [주문 내역] 불고기 덮밥 1개 | 배달비 3,000원 | 도착 예정 시간 오후 7시 40분
Write this request in Korean using 문 앞 and 벨 (Please leave it outside the door and don't ring the bell.): ____
Complete the request so it means 'You don't need to give me disposable spoons and chopsticks.': 일회용 수저는 ____.
Choose the right word (주문 취소 / 리뷰): 음식이 정말 맛있어서 별 다섯 개를 주고 ____를 남겼어요.
answers: At 7:40 p.m.; the delivery fee is 3,000 won.
문 앞에 두고 벨은 누르지 말아 주세요. (문 앞에 놓고 벨은 누르지 마세요.)
안 주셔도 돼요 (안 주셔도 괜찮아요 / 빼 주세요)
